description: Wire the new foundation (FEAT-002) into all pages to deliver the user-facing behavior: (1) login-gated entry so the app shows LOGIN first and no one browses the catalog without authenticating; (2) every book card renders a monochrome cover image; (3) all state-changing actions (borrow, return, delete book/category, create/edit book) require an explicit, clearly-labeled button plus a confirmation step before firing, with clear success/error feedback and loading/disabled states. Depends on FEAT-002. No backend contract changes; keep plain HTML/CSS/vanilla JS.
steps: LOGIN GATE - frontend/index.html: at the top of the inline <script> (after api.js/nav.js load, before loading data), call `Auth.requireLogin()` so unauthenticated visitors are redirected to login.html and the catalog is never shown to anonymous users. Remove the now-dead anonymous path in borrowBook() that redirected to login (since the whole page is gated). Keep renderNavbar('index').

LOGIN GATE - confirm my-loans.html already calls Auth.requireLogin() and admin.html calls Auth.requireAdmin() (they do); leave those. Confirm login.html and register.html still redirect logged-in users to index.html (they do). Net effect: first load with no session => login.html; after login => index.html catalog. This makes login.html the effective entry point for new users.

COVER IMAGES - frontend/index.html renderBooks(): replace the current `
\u{1F4D6}
` emoji placeholder with an whose src is bookCoverSvg(book) (from FEAT-002), wrapped so the FEAT-002 `.book-cover img` styles apply. Include an alt of the book title (escaped). Every rendered book must show this generated monochrome cover.

BORROW CONFIRMATION - frontend/index.html: the 'Pinjam' button must NOT borrow on a single unguarded click. In borrowBook(bookId), first show `UI.confirm({title:'Pinjam Buku', message:'Anda yakin ingin meminjam buku ini? Buku akan tercatat pada peminjaman Anda.', confirmText:'Ya, Pinjam', cancelText:'Batal'})` and only call Api.borrowBook(bookId) if it resolves true. While the request is in-flight, disable the clicked button and show a loading label; on success show UI.toast (or existing success alert) 'Buku berhasil dipinjam! Batas waktu 7 hari.' and reload the list; on error show the error via UI.toast/alert and re-enable. Ensure the borrow button has clear labeling and is the only way to trigger a borrow (no click-anywhere-on-card borrow).

RETURN CONFIRMATION - frontend/my-loans.html returnLoan(id): before calling Api.returnLoan(id), require UI.confirm({title:'Kembalikan Buku', message:'Kembalikan buku ini sekarang?', confirmText:'Ya, Kembalikan', cancelText:'Batal'}). Add loading/disabled state on the clicked button and success/error feedback. Keep the existing return button clearly labeled 'Kembalikan'.

ADMIN CONFIRMATIONS - frontend/admin.html: replace the native `confirm(...)` calls in deleteBook() and deleteCategory() with the new UI.confirm(...) monochrome dialog (e.g. title 'Hapus Buku'/'Hapus Kategori', destructive confirm label). Additionally, for the create/edit book form submit and the add-category action, ensure the action only fires on the explicit Simpan / + Tambah button (they already do) and add a UI.confirm step for the potentially-destructive/edit save if appropriate (at minimum keep explicit buttons; a confirm on delete is required, confirm on create/edit is optional but recommended for edits). Add loading/disabled states on the save/delete buttons while requests are in flight, and route feedback through UI.toast or the existing alerts.

FEEDBACK CONSISTENCY - across index/my-loans/admin, ensure every state-changing action ends in a visible success or error message (UI.toast or the .alert-success/.alert-error divs already present) so users always know what happened. Ensure no action happens silently or accidentally.

COPY/README - optional: update frontend/README.md and/or root README.md wording that describes the theme as 'biru muda & putih' to reflect the new black-and-white theme, if time permits (keep changes minimal and accurate).
Verify `node --check frontend/assets/js/api.js` and `node --check frontend/assets/js/nav.js` pass, and serve the frontend to smoke-test that pages load without console errors.
acceptance_criteria: Opening index.html without a session redirects to login.html (catalog is not viewable while logged out); after logging in the user lands on index.html.
Every book card in the catalog renders a monochrome cover image produced by bookCoverSvg(book) (no missing/broken images, no network dependency).

Clicking 'Pinjam' shows a confirmation dialog and only borrows after the user confirms; the same applies to Kembalikan (return) and to admin Hapus Buku/Hapus Kategori (via UI.confirm, not native confirm).
Every borrow/return/delete/create action shows a success or error message and uses a disabled/loading state on its button while in flight.
`node --check` passes on api.js and nav.js; the static server serves all pages (login, register, index, my-loans, admin) with HTTP 200 and no JS console errors on load.
verification: cd frontend && python3 -m http.server 5500 & sleep 1 && for p in login register index my-loans admin; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$p %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5500/$p.html; done
findings: COMPLETED on branch main. Wired the FEAT-002 foundation (bookCoverSvg, UI.toast, UI.confirm) into all pages. No backend/api.js/nav.js helper-definition changes. frontend/index.html: - LOGIN GATE: added `Auth.requireLogin();` as the first line of the inline
